description.narrative: The project aims to cover two aspects of the problems faced by the farmers during this critical period in their cultivation cycle: 1) Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) for farmers who need to do field visits on a continuous basis in order to follow the package of practices and should be protected from the transmission of the coronavirus. In addition, the PPE will also offer protection from harmful chemicals during crop production. 2) Another challenge farmers face nowadays is the lack of infrastructure for soil testing and dosage recommendation for crop production. The current infrastructure provided by the government is typically at the district headquarters or in major towns. The solution proposed is to set up smaller portable soil testing kits at the cluster level that could be used by farmers this season to avoid travel during the COVID-19 period. Waycool will leverage grant funds to build these portable soil test labs and perform the first set of tests.
